Coconut minimal caption helper: third-party notices

These notices accompany the pinned yt-dlp 2026.08.19 / CPython 3.14.8 /
PyInstaller 6.22.3 / certifi 2026.7.22 helper build. Coconut uses official
upstream inputs to make its own limited helper; this is not the upstream
all-dependencies yt-dlp executable.

See sources.json for the source URL and SHA-256 of each vendored notice.
python-runtime-input.json describes the inspected Python installer, not a
claim that every installer component is included in the final helper.
The release's final per-architecture inventory determines the actual contents.
Candidate native-component notices are retained even when excluded.

CPython packaging changes consist of file selection/layout, freezing Python
modules and possible universal2 architecture thinning. No upstream Python,
native-library or PyInstaller bootloader/runtime source files are modified.
Original source copyright and license notices are preserved here.

SOURCE CODE FOR CERTIFI (MOZILLA PUBLIC LICENSE 2.0)

Complete, unmodified certifi Source Code Form, including cacert.pem, is
provided with this application in sources/certifi-2026.7.22.tar.gz, relative
to this notice. Its exact upstream download URL and SHA-256 appear in
sources.json. You may use, modify and redistribute the covered source under
MPL-2.0; see LICENSE.MPL-2.0 and LICENSE.certifi. No Coconut term is intended
to restrict your rights to this component under that license.

The other components' source references are in sources.json and
python-runtime-input.json. Refer to docs/caption-helper-licenses.md in the
Coconut source distribution for the component scope and release checks.
